# ScribeCat 0.25.20

### Links and tabs
- Prevent a single external-link click from opening both the browser and a second app/web window.
- Highlight both note tabs when two documents are visible in split view.
- Keep the most recently active document first in the tab bar.

### PDF viewer
- Make arrow keys page through the multi-page overview while overview mode is active.
- Cap tall inline PDF viewers in the text editor and fit the complete page inside the available height.
- Use two overview columns in narrower split and small-screen layouts when space allows.
- Base multi-page thumbnail sizing on the viewer height rather than the source page height.
- Switch the PDF toolbar to two rows before controls overlap at narrow widths.
- Preserve the current finger/viewport anchor when pinch zoom begins on mobile fullscreen, avoiding the jump to the top.

### Server and Docker
- Release metadata and Compose defaults are updated to 0.25.20.
- Publish the exact multi-architecture server image as `ghcr.io/reidar96/scribecat-server:0.25.20`.
